marks.text: the inner wall copied onto the sidewalk with its two doors
the counter's south section moved 2 tiles south (under the roof)
the inner cross wall deleted (under the roof)
the upstairs floor strip copied 2 tiles north (under the roof)
corpses: one copied, one moved, one deleted (if the game shows corpses here at all)

marks.text: full cover along it, no sight through it; explosives break it a column at a time

marks.text: the counter section here: low cover; its old place (south side of the island) is open
no wall here: walk and see through; what hung on it still hangs

shots.title: EXP-28 run 1: the floor strip's copy, upstairs over the front room

marks.text: the cursor lands on its top (about 210); a soldier put there stands and walks along it
the strip it was copied from
